verdict.rationale: Forter provides extensive REST API references (Order v3, Order Status, Evidence API, webhooks), a sandbox/production environment, and even a documented MCP server for agentic workflows, which together give an AI-native developer solid material to build against. However, none of the evidence explicitly names or links to official client-language SDKs (e.g., Python/Node/Java packages) — only API/reference docs and an MCP integration are shown. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK packages/libraries, versioned SDK release notes, and independent corroboration of SDK usage in production.
